g.text: Rust server in clean layers, a Bun app, the web UI, plugins and the MT5 bridge

svg.text: ow-domain defines the ports the outer layers code against
ow-crosscutting adds the shared kernel and the MessageBus
LiveGateway implements the Gateway port in front of all sources
It keeps a hot bar window and persists closed bars to LibSQL
The SourceRegistry runs one actor task per source
Connector crates adapt MT5, Binance, OANDA, IBKR and more
Adapter events enter the gateway only through ingest()
ow-mt5 talks HTTP and WebSocket to a bridge inside MT5
The EA loads the bridge DLL over FFI and trades via CTrade
Other venues are reached with HTTPS and WebSocket clients
News and economic-calendar feeds are polled over HTTP
ingest() fans each event out to indicators and bots
Rust plugins are cdylibs loaded in-process over the C ABI
ow-application builds the container and reaches the Gateway port
ow-api serves REST, SSE and plugin WebSockets with Axum
Events leave through the MessageBus as one SSE broadcast
The same bytes can also be recorded to Redis Streams
The openwick binary (ow-cli) starts the server via start()
ow-bootstrap wires the bus, sinks, sources and the router
The Bun app (cli.ts) is the entry for TUI, serve and web modes
It spawns the Rust binary as a sidecar and waits for /health
The terminal UI talks to the API over REST plus SSE
JS plugins load in Bun and speak JSON over WebSocket
The SolidJS web UI, in a browser or Electron, uses the same API
AI agents call MCP tools that proxy to the REST API
Shared TS packages carry the OpenAPI-generated wire types
Every path meets at one façade: the LiveGateway
